story.fullStory:
The Sanford/townsend Band's "Smoke From A Distant Fire" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Smoke from a Distant Fire" is a song by American duo Sanford-Townsend Band.

It was released as a single in 1977 from their self-titled album.

9 on the Billboard Hot 100 on the week ending September 17, 1977, becoming the duo's only Top 40 hit.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.
